module: Spline manager of the Drive Path Editor (prefix "Drive Path Spline", edit mode drivePathSplineEditMode). A path spline describes a route for an AI: nodes, widths, normals, speeds (vels) and speed limits (velLimits) in free mode, or a list of navgraph nodes (graphNodes/graphPath) in graph mode. The module holds the list of splines and the id-to-index table, handles creation, deletion, splitting, joining, reversing, undo/redo, serialization, spline-vehicle links (which move the vehicle back to the start) and the map's navgraph cache (map.getGraphpath()).
notes: Default spline parameters: isFreeMode true, delayTime 0 s, aggression 0.3, numLaps 1, routeSpeed 31.3 (m/s), routeSpeedMode 'off', isAvoidCars true, isDriveInLane true, isLoop false, startingNode 1, speedProfileMode 0 (0 none, 1 target speeds, 2 speed limits, free script only).
Constants: minimum subdivisions 10; gap at split 1.0 m; minimum import size 10 m; vehicle vertical offset 0.3 m (vehShiftZ); ribbon points sampled by raycast with zExtra 3.0 and zFloat 0.15.

A scene vehicle is a table {vid, veh, name, isLink, linkSplineId}; a linked spline has isVehicleLink and linkVehId. linkSpline immediately moves the vehicle to the start and stores its original pose; unlinkSpline restores it.
Splines are recomputed by updateDirtyDrivePathSplines when isDirty is true. In graph mode, a spline stays dirty as long as the navgraph is not available.
getNavGraph returns nil until map.getGraphpath() exists; otherwise it caches {graph, nodes (positions), widths (radius), lines} for all edges (once per edge).
convertPathsToDrivePathSplines creates one spline per path even if too small (it stays empty) and its log counts #paths - #drivePathSplines (inexact if splines already existed).

getToolPrefixStr.desc: Returns the tool prefix ("Drive Path Spline").

getSplineMap.desc: Returns the spline id to index table.

setDrivePathSpline.desc: Places a spline at an index and marks it isDirty.

setDrivePathSplines.desc: Places all splines of an array (each marked isDirty).

computeActiveVehicles.desc: Rebuilds the list of active scene vehicles (activeVehiclesIterator) with vid, veh, name and links reset.

getActiveVehicles.desc: Returns the list of active vehicles; recomputes it if it is empty or if isForce is true.

returns.desc: array of {vid, veh, name, isLink, linkSplineId}

getVehicleById.desc: Looks for a vehicle in the already computed list (without recomputing it).

getNavGraph.desc: Returns the map's navgraph data (cache), computing it on the first call if possible.

returns.desc: {graph, nodes, widths, lines} or nil if the graph is not yet available

getDefaultSliderParams.desc: Returns the default values of the spline parameters.

resetGeometry.desc: Clears all the geometry of a spline (nodes, widths, nmls, vels, velLimits, graphNodes, graphPath) and marks it isDirty.

addNewDrivePathSpline.desc: Appends a new empty spline with a unique name, an Engine.generateUUID() UUID and the default parameters.

removeDrivePathSpline.desc: Removes the spline at the given index and updates the index table.

removeAllDrivePathSplines.desc: Removes splines. With isIncludeDisabled true, all of them; otherwise only the enabled ones.

deepCopyDrivePathSpline.desc: Deep copy of a spline (for history).

splitDrivePathSpline.desc: Splits a spline in two at the given node (1.0 m gap between the two parts).

joinDrivePathSplines.desc: Joins two non-looped splines: the first receives the concatenated geometry, the second is removed.

flipSpline.desc: Reverses the direction of a spline: nodes, widths, normals, speeds and speed limits are reversed.

resetVehiclePose.desc: Places the vehicle at the spline's start node (startingNode), oriented along the neighboring nodes, with a 0.3 m vertical offset. Stores its original pose only once. In graph mode, uses the navgraph nodes (requires the cache).

linkSpline.desc: Links a spline to a vehicle (isVehicleLink, linkVehId, linkSplineId) and moves the vehicle back to the start.

unlinkSpline.desc: Removes the spline-vehicle link and gives the vehicle back its stored original pose.

relinkAllVehiclesToSplines.desc: Relinks all splines to their vehicle (via linkVehId) by searching the computed vehicle list.

singleSplineEditUndo.desc: Undoes a single spline edit from drivePathSplineData.old, then relinks the vehicles.

singleSplineEditRedo.desc: Redoes a single spline edit from drivePathSplineData.new.

transSplineEditUndo.desc: Undoes a global edit (all splines) with data.old.

transSplineEditRedo.desc: Redoes a global edit with data.new.

serializeDrivePathSpline.desc: Serializes a spline into a table.

deserializeDrivePathSpline.desc: Rebuilds a spline from a serialized table.

updateDirtyDrivePathSplines.desc: Recomputes the geometry of isDirty splines (terrain raycasts, speed bars, ribbon in free mode; graph path in navgraph mode). Called every frame by onEditorGui.

convertPathsToDrivePathSplines.desc: Converts paths from an image into splines (see notes for the cases of paths that are too small).
